name: swe-process
description: Governed end-to-end software engineering workflows for portfolio and solution repositories.

interface.longDescription: Turns portfolio intent into research, concepts, federated architecture, Features, implementation assignments, solution designs, code, evidence, and independent validation.
defaultPrompt: Use $swe-new-epic to begin governed portfolio work.
Use $swe-architect to create or reconcile architecture at the active repository's maximum authority.
Use $swe-scaffold -portfolio or -solution to extend an active repository without overwriting files.
